name: Discover Petra
author: Addicting Games
description: Discover Petra is a puzzle game based on the archeological discoveries of Petra. Travel with Petra as she uncovers artifacts from all around the world. There are vases, musical instruments, books, and other interesting items. At the bottom of the screen, you will find 4 people who are looking for a particular artifact. Find their item as fast you can to get the best possible score. There are 10 levels of this casual hidden object game for you to solve. Play quickly as you can to beat the clock!
